row.scim_plan: Amazon Business account (free; no Prime Business plan required)
row.evidence: Amazon Business says "SCIM for Amazon Business is now available with Okta and Azure customers globally", and Microsoft's provisioning tutorial lists only an Amazon Business account and an Admin user as prerequisites; no Prime Business plan gates SSO or SCIM.
row.notes: Amazon Business accounts are free; Prime Business is an optional shipping/analytics membership (Duo free, Essentials $179/yr up to 5 users, Small $499/yr, Medium $1,299/yr, Enterprise $10,099/yr), flat-priced so per-user fields stay null. SSO (SAML 2.0, self-service) and SCIM are configured in Business Settings with no listed charge; SCIM needs SSO active first. SCIM works with Okta and Microsoft Entra only (two IdPs, so not partial), not with Punchout, and for only one Legal Entity per account. No generic SCIM token: IdPs authorise through Amazon's OAuth endpoint. Deprovisioning deactivates users. Separate User Management API (create users only) is granted via the Amazon Business technical contact.

plans.name: Amazon Business account (no membership)
plans.notes: SSO/SCIM availability inferred from setup docs that list only an Amazon Business account as prerequisite.

scim.plan: Amazon Business account (no Prime Business plan required)
scim.base_url: https://na.business-api.amazon.com/scim/v2/ (US, CA, MX); eu.business-api.amazon.com (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, IN); jp.business-api.amazon.com (JP, AU)

auth.token_source: IdP authorises through an Amazon Business OAuth endpoint (e.g. https://www.amazon.com/b2b/abws/oauth?...&applicationId=...) entered in the IdP app's Admin Credentials; no static token is shown

endpoints.notes: Endpoint paths are not published; Entra and Okta push users and groups to the regional /scim/v2/ tenant URL.

operations.notes: Okta OIN marks Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push; Entra lists create, remove, attribute sync, roles, groups and memberships. Whether PUT or PATCH is used is not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users stay in the Default SCIM Users Group (Requisitioner role); order data retention is not documented.

roles.how: Entra 'roles' attribute from appRoleAssignments; users without a group land in the Default SCIM Users Group as Requisitioner

limitations.text: SCIM works only with Okta and Microsoft Entra (Azure); not with Punchout.
SCIM can be enabled for only one Legal Entity per Amazon Business account.
Okta: SCIM provisioning only works with the default OIN application, not a custom SAML app.

scim.notes: Prerequisites listed by Microsoft are only an Amazon Business account and an Admin user; neither the Prime Business plan table nor the SSO page ties SSO or SCIM to a paid plan. SCIM is enabled in Business Settings > Identity Management (SCIM) after SSO is active.

endpoints.purpose: Create a business user account in a group with a role (createBusinessUserAccount)

rate_limits.text: createBusinessUserAccount default usage plan: 1 request/second, burst 5 (per application-customer pair).

limitations.text: The API only creates users; no list, update or deactivate operations are documented.
Account Authority must be enabled so the email domain is allow-listed.

user_api.notes: Access to the User Management role is granted by the Amazon Business technical contact after API developer onboarding; no plan gate or fee is published.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from page markup).

google.notes: Amazon publishes a Google Workspace SAML guide; SCIM is Okta/Azure only. Google catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not loaded; Amazon lists OneLogin as a SAML IdP and SCIM as Okta/Azure only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Punchout from e-procurement systems (Ariba, Coupa, etc.) also creates users

open_questions: Amazon's own Okta SCIM configuration PDF (amazon.com/ab/sso/files/OktaSCIMIntegrationWithAmazonBusiness.pdf) returned a bot-block page, so SCIM endpoints, PUT/PATCH support, delete behaviour and token lifetime are not confirmed.
No page states explicitly that SSO/SCIM carry no charge or are independent of Prime Business; this is inferred from the prerequisites and the plan table.
Whether a deactivated user frees anything (no seat pricing) or keeps order history is not documented.
No audit-log API or user-event webhooks found in the Amazon Business API docs.
